item.title: Is Slipknot Releasing a New Album in 2025? Here’s What We Know So Far
item.description: Slipknot fans are eagerly awaiting news of the band’s next studio album following 2022’s The End, So Far. While a new record hasn’t been officially announced, the band members have dropped numerous hints in recent interviews about their plans.
